release_notes:
## Drag to add or remove episodes on the VFX tab too
- The DETECTED EPISODES tags now click-and-drag exactly like the EXPORT QUEUE chips added in 1.0.16: whichever way the first tag flips is applied to every tag you drag across, so dragging over a mix sets them all the same way instead of inverting each one
- A plain click still toggles a single tag, and tags stay locked while an export is running
